break_timing_sigma_s.description: Standard deviation of the timing of a defensive break.

commitment_s.description: Shortest time the pilot keeps a decision before changing it.

defend_delay_s.description: Delay before the pilot reacts to being fired at.

extend_below_cas_mps.description: Calibrated airspeed below which the pilot extends (0 for never).

extend_until_cas_mps.description: Calibrated airspeed at which the pilot stops extending.

fires_gun.description: True if the pilot fires its gun.

g_frac.description: Fraction of the aircraft's load-factor limit the pilot will pull.

gun_aim_sigma_mrad.description: Standard deviation of the pilot's gun aim error.

id.description: `namespace:type/name`, with namespace the pack id and type `skl`.

name_key.description: Key of the display name in the locale table.

notice_prob.description: Probability per decision that the pilot notices an incoming missile it can see.

perception_delay_s.description: Delay between something becoming visible and the pilot acting on it.

rank.description: Position in the ladder, 1 for the lowest. Ranks in a pack are 1 to n, each once.

terrain_min_agl_m.description: Lowest height above the ground the pilot will fly at.
